title: DATING APP (TINDER)
subtitle: Swipes are a firehose of writes, and two people swiping right at the same moment must never miss their match.

items: Precompute the next ~200 candidates per user in Redis and refresh in the background. A per-user Bloom filter hides profiles already swiped.
Swipes are write-heavy (100k/s) and append-only, so an LSM store like Cassandra fits.
Match race: A and B swipe right at the same moment, and each check misses the other.
Both swipe at once: why can a match be missed?
Two writes followed by two reads: each read runs before the other's write lands. That is write skew (Ch 7).
Hide already-swiped profiles?
A Bloom filter per user. A false positive skips an unseen profile, which is acceptable; no false negatives.
Location changes?
Invalidate and recompute the stack when the user moves more than X km.
Separate "write swipe" and "check other swipe" calls without atomicity, so matches are lost.
Adding parts before a number shows they are needed.
Ignoring retries, timeouts and crashes.
